mechanism: Tobramycin-induced nephrotoxicity can impair renal function, reducing dapagliflozin efficacy and increasing risk of euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis (euDKA) and acute kidney injury.
action: Monitor renal function closely (eGFR and serum creatinine) during tobramycin therapy; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; assess for euDKA symptoms (nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, dyspnea).
